title: TaskingRequest
description: The initiating message in ENSIM's representative tasking sequence (ARCHITECTURE.md Section 3: request → validate → ATO line → execution → report) — a host-nation or embassy request for assistance. Grounded in org-doctrine-model's hadr-request-and-tasking-flow doctrine process, step 1 ('Assistance request').

doctrineProcessStep.description: stepNumber in the referenced Mission's DoctrineProcess this message corresponds to.

requestingParty.description: Free text, e.g. 'Philippine government / U.S. Embassy Manila' — not a role/org id, since the requester is external to the org-doctrine-model hierarchy this scenario models.
